sn_flow_summary.summary:
This subflow retrieves travel alerts issued by the HK Security Bureau for a specified destination country.
It takes a single input, "Country", which is used to look up the corresponding travel alert record.
The subflow then checks if a travel alert record is found. If a record is found, it assigns the travel alert classification, details, and recommendations as outputs. If no record is found, it assigns "No Travel Alerts" as the travel alert classification output.
